title: G7: Jump cards with a visible target (M)
description:
Jump and branch cards show where they land.
Acceptance:
- Given a jump card, then its target card is highlighted in the card list.
- When it runs, the highlight moves with the pc.
- The card text names the target in STE.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Kept and re-parented to RM W5 (SIE-22eed3): jump cards with a visible target may be needed by the branch lesson c1/20 at card level; close if the branch arrow covers it.
